note: The operator's real distribution model, stated by him on 2026-11-13. This file replaces the three-account guess in social.json, which was written on 2026-11-03 from workspace defaults and never confirmed. He has TWO accounts, both of which publish to EVERY platform. This is not the same shape as channels.json: channels.json describes YouTube channels with per-channel configs; this file describes the two identities that own the social accounts, because one short is cut once and delivered to four platforms at once.

shorts.rule: Cut once. Deliver to all four. The same file, not four edits.
shorts.cadence: as often as quality allows — both accounts, every week

long_form.rule: YouTube only. Never posted to TikTok, Instagram or Facebook.
long_form.why_capped: stated by the operator: hafte mein 1 ya 2 baar, sirf YouTube par

the_model.why_two_shapes: Shorts are a distribution game — the same 40 seconds earns on four platforms. Long-form is a trust game — it only works where people subscribe, which is YouTube. Treating them as one pipeline is what produced the earlier confusion.

accounts.label: Motivational / Self Improvement
accounts.handle_note: The operator typed this with a leading space and an opening double-quote. Neither is part of a handle: Meta and TikTok reject both characters. Stored verbatim in handle_raw so nobody thinks the cleaner value was invented; handle is the value to actually use.
accounts.voice: direct, Roman-Urdu + English, no lecture tone

accounts.label: AI Learning & Earning
accounts.handle_note: Stored exactly as the operator gave it. He did not say whether the leading dot form or an @-prefixed form is the actual TikTok/Facebook handle — those platforms do not all use dots. Verify before the first automated post; a wrong handle publishes to a stranger's account or fails.

banned: AI-generated faces presented as the creator

rules: A short is cut once and delivered to all four platforms. It is never re-edited per platform.
A long video is YouTube only. Posting it to TikTok/Instagram/Facebook is a defect, not a bonus.
Long-form is capped at 1-2 per week on purpose. The cap is the point, not a limitation to work around.
The two accounts never share a voice. Motivational and AI-learning speak differently or the second one reads as a repost.
Nothing is published with an unverified handle. handle_unverified is true on both accounts until checked against the live platform.
The operator publishes by hand. The agent delivers a finished file and the caption text, then stops.

known_gaps.what: Neither handle has been confirmed against TikTok, Instagram, Facebook or YouTube.
known_gaps.why_it_matters: A wrong handle publishes to someone else's account or fails silently at the API.
known_gaps.fix: Read the handle off each platform's own profile page once. Set handle_unverified to false.

known_gaps.what: config/social.json still lists soc-01/soc-02/soc-03 with an invented @mycreatorpage handle and an X/LinkedIn audience for the AI account.
known_gaps.why_it_matters: Two files describing the same accounts will drift, and src/lib/config.js reads social.json for the app UI.
known_gaps.fix: Point src/lib/config.js at this file, then reduce social.json to a redirect note. Deferred because changing the UI read path needs a build, and the operator has not asked for the app UI to change.

known_gaps.what: There is no upload path. Not to YouTube, not to TikTok, not to Instagram, not to Facebook.
known_gaps.why_it_matters: Nothing. He uploads himself, so a missing API path costs no work. Recorded only so a future session does not spend hours re-measuring the four blocked hosts.
known_gaps.fix: NOT needed unless the operator asks. He publishes by hand as of 2026-11-13. If he ever asks: build .github/workflows/publish-short.yml. Needs YouTube OAuth for video upload (the existing YT_API_KEY is read-only and cannot upload), a Meta app with Instagram Graph + Pages permissions, and a TikTok Content Posting API approval. Meta and TikTok each need an application review measured in weeks — start both before writing the workflow.

publishing.operator_words: Acha upload me khud kardunga filhal baaqi sab theek ha
means: Do NOT build an upload automation. It was not asked for and it is not wanted right now.
The agent's job ends when the finished file exists and is reachable: in Drive, or in a GitHub Release.
Give the operator the file plus the exact caption/hashtags, and stop. Do not print a tutorial on how to upload.
This is 'filhal' — for now. If he asks for automation later, gap-upload-not-built in known_gaps still holds every finding, including the app-review lead times.
what_the_agent_still_owes: The short cut to the right spec: 9:16 vertical, 30-45 s, safe margins for four platforms at once.
A caption and hashtag set that works on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube Shorts and Facebook without editing.
The file named so it is obvious which account it belongs to.
